freeze_semantics: Content-hash freeze of the claude-code adapter's output over the conformance-scenario corpus at harness 2.1.215. verify.py re-runs preprocess+DSL on each input (with cwd = this dir and input paths relative to it) and asserts trace_count, per-trace content_hash, and unmapped_path_count match. The adapter is deterministic. NOTE: content_hash folds in provenance.source_path, so inputs MUST stay at inputs/<name>.jsonl for the hashes to reproduce; verify.py enforces the relative-path convention. This catches ADAPTER drift; format (Axis-C) drift is caught separately by drift_watch.py. annotated_cells_fired is the structural fired-cell set from the verified 2.1.215 capture (drift self-test asserts it equals the extractor exactly). The agent_listing_delta payload (addedTypes/removedTypes/showConcurrencyNote) and the delegation Task-result resolvedModel are accepted as registration/redundant noise here: resolvedModel duplicates the delegated sub-trace's environment.model, reachable via spawned_agent.sub_session_id; the agent_listing_delta payload is the 2.1.215 successor of 2.1.153's deferred_tools_delta payload, same session-start registration role. Neither introduces a new modelled field, so this cycle adds zero new spec first-deployment candidates.
